query:
UPDATE ai_usage_machines
                SET last_snapshot_at = CASE
                    WHEN $2::timestamptz <= now() + interval '5 minutes' THEN $2::timestamptz
                    ELSE last_snapshot_at
                END
                WHERE id = $1
                  AND (last_snapshot_at IS NULL OR last_snapshot_at <= $2::timestamptz)
                RETURNING id
